mapper.select: select s.ses_id as sessionId, s.ses_candidate_id as candidateId, s.ses_cascade_round as round, s.ses_mode as mode, s.ses_rec_url as recUrl, e.evl_overall_score as overallScore, cast(e.evl_dimension_scores as char) as dimensionScores, e.evl_summary as summary, e.evl_advantages as advantages, e.evl_risks as risks, e.evl_gaps as gaps, e.evl_recommendation as recommendation, e.evl_hr_status as hrStatus, e.evl_hr_comment as hrComment, e.evl_hr_recommendation as hrRecommendation, u.nick_name as candidateName, pos.pos_title as positionTitle from t_int_session s join t_int_evaluation e on e.evl_session_id = s.ses_id left join t_tal t on t.tal_id = s.ses_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id left join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = s.ses_position_id where s.ses_id = #{sessionId}

select s.ses_id as sessionId, s.ses_candidate_id as candidateId, s.ses_position_id as positionId, s.ses_interviewer_id as interviewerId, s.ses_template_id as templateId, s.ses_cascade_round as round, e.evl_overall_score as overallScore, t.tal_user_id as candidateUserId, pos.pos_title as positionTitle from t_int_session s left join t_int_evaluation e on e.evl_session_id = s.ses_id left join t_tal t on t.tal_id = s.ses_candidate_id left join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = s.ses_position_id where s.ses_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.update: update t_int_evaluation set evl_hr_status = #{hrStatus}, evl_hr_recommendation = #{hrRecommendation}, evl_hr_comment = #{hrComment}, evl_hr_updated_at = now() where evl_session_id = #{sessionId}
update t_int_evaluation set evl_dimension_scores = #{dimsJson}, evl_overall_score = #{overallScore}, evl_hr_updated_at = now() where evl_session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: select csr_id as ruleId, csr_template_id as templateId, csr_current_round as round, csr_dimension as dimension, csr_pass_threshold as passThreshold, csr_action_pass as actionPass, csr_action_fail as actionFail from t_int_cascade_rule where csr_template_id = #{templateId} and csr_current_round = #{round} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_sch_appointment (apt_candidate_id, apt_position_id, apt_interviewer_id, apt_start_time, apt_end_time, apt_status) values (#{candidateId}, #{positionId}, #{interviewerId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, 0)
insert into t_msg (msg_receiver_id, msg_sender_id, msg_type, msg_title, msg_content, msg_is_read) values (#{receiverId}, 0, 1, #{title}, #{content}, 0)
